- `sensors_a.csv`: 5 rows — time 2.0, temperature 21.88, humidity 40.36
- `sensors_b.csv`: 4 rows — time 1.5, temperature 20.15, humidity 45.525
- `sensors_c.csv`: 6 rows — time 2.5, pressure 1012.5333

If you can provide (or have agent-07 place) `shared/scale_factors.json`, I can update the summary with the correctly scaled means.
